phases.name: fold manifests / source-dev / isolation locks
phases.gate: FOLD_ISOLATION_PASS == true for the fold; source/dev manifests subject-disjoint where required

phases.name: fold-specific GPAT + quality runtime preparation
phases.gate: E7-A complete for the fold; GPAT support fit and quality backend resolvable on the GPU host
phases.resume_identity: fold GPAT support identity + quality calibration identity

phases.name: synthetic generation + matching feasibility (RND/DET/LLM, and Shuffle where the preflight plan applies)
phases.gate: E7-B complete; per condition, render + frozen quality evaluation + frozen matched-bank feasibility check (Task F's rule) all pass
phases.resume_identity: per-arm matched-bank lock identity or BLOCKED_SCIENTIFIC_INFEASIBILITY record

phases.name: detector training, 5 seeds per feasible condition/fold
phases.gate: E7-C feasible for that condition/fold cell (or condition is G-REALONLY, which skips E7-C entirely)

phases.name: label-free target prediction
phases.gate: E7-D checkpoint exists and passed source-dev checkpoint selection
phases.resume_identity: prediction artifact identity; target labels never read here

phases.name: controlled scoring / aggregation
phases.gate: E7-E predictions exist for every seed of a condition/fold cell
phases.resume_identity: aggregate result identity; per-seed rows preserved before aggregation
